## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the parsed domain part (after the @) of a first-class [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) — the component that reveals the provider and underlies the personal-domain usage role.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one domain part per address (it is functional) and avoid treating it as fully public — paired with the local part it re-forms sensitive personal data.

### How to use

- Derive the domain part from [`gmeow:addressValue`](gmeow-addressValue.md); read it to infer the provider or a personal-domain classification, and keep it under the address's sensitivity when projecting.

### Examples

- ex:lillithEmail [`gmeow:domainPart`](gmeow-domainPart.md) "example.org".
